blocks.x: Operational telemetry
What we watch so you do not have to ask:

items: constraint violations
Constraint breaches counted per plan cycle — a plan that violates a constraint never ships silently.
planner override rate
Overrides counted and reviewed monthly — a high rate is a model problem or a trust problem, and both are fixable.
plan quality gap
The gap between plan and actual reported per cycle — planners see where their assumptions lied.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: Black-box plans
Black-box plans: each committed plan carries a binding-constraint report; unexplainable schedules never reach execution; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Constraint hiding
Constraint hiding — planners can mark any output infeasible; every rejection trains the formulation, not the planner, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Solver worship
Solver worship — guarded because a quantum-inspired result that cannot beat the classical baseline is rejected by default — benchmarks are published
